about_the_game:
YOUR PREHISTORIC MUSEUM IS HERE!

In Paleo Collector, you can have a large collection of fossils, from the shy Dodo to the fearsome T. rex to the ancient Trilobite. Manage your museum, improve it, and grow it little by little. Fund excavations to obtain more fossils and decorative items to attract your visitors.

EXCAVATE. PROCESS. DISPLAY

Your excavation fields will be the starting point for obtaining your fossil pieces. Excavate and collect the rocks. Take them to your storage and, with your tools, gather all the pieces to uncover the fossil and display it in your museum.

JURASSIC ART

Decorate with a wide variety of objects and let your imagination create the museum of your dreams. Place your decorative posters wherever you want and adorn your floors with incredible designs. Prehistory finds its way into modern and futuristic art.

WELCOME PALEOFANS

Attract fossil enthusiasts to your museum with every announcement, captivating them with the enormous dinosaurs, ancient Cambrian dinosaurs, and megafauna. Increase their satisfaction with the exhibits so they'll return and purchase something to support your museum.

EVOLUTIONARY MUSEUM

As you progress through your adventure, unlock useful features for your museum, such as a new section to display more fossils, a shop to increase your profits, new decorations, and advanced excavations to obtain ancient fossils.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-2300/AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GTX 560 (2GB)/AMD Radeon 7850 (2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-4770/AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GTX 980 (4GB)/AMD R9 380 (4GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: Excavate, process, and display your fossils in Paleo Collector. Manage your museum and unlock amazing upgrades. Decorate it and attract bone enthusiasts. A journey through time to create the ultimate prehistoric museum.
